description: Holding the Bell at Black pond shows the Forest Clearing to that traveler. Holding it in the clearing shows the way back. Anyone else sees a locked box.

crossings.opened: The Bell in hand folds the pond, and a forest clearing comes into view.
crossings.closed: The Bell leaves the hand. The reflected clearing fades from the pond.

scenery.open: The Bell is in hand, and the dark reflection between the roots opens onto Black pond.

crossings.opened: A dark reflection between the roots opens onto Black pond.
crossings.closed: The Bell leaves the hand. The reflection between the roots fades.
